boneFrameLegContour.normalMethod: authored normals transported by welded surface shortest-arc rotation

forelegTaper.method: Continuous cannon-to-forearm radial taper without the former knee peak/above-knee dip

legContour.method: Smooth anisotropic attenuation of added draft width around the original named pastern and knee/hock joints. Broad lateral hoof and shaft volume remain; low toe/heel forward flare returns to the source envelope.
legContour.preserved: Source geometry is never reduced. All source joints, weights, clips, standing sole anchors, lower-leg height and body above1.10m remain unchanged; only added X/Z draft shape is attenuated.

upperLegContour.method: Smoothly taper only added draft X/Y/Z volume through the original stifle into the upper hindquarter. This separates overlapping torso and radial-limb mass over a broad anatomical region without shrinking the source surface.
upperLegContour.preserved: Lower-leg contour through0.72m, forebody from sourceZ-0.15m, upper body above1.65m, all source body weights, joints and clips; nonbody morphs and reviewed collar append remain unchanged.

draftShape.hoofCenterMethod: XZ centroid, weighted by smoothstep(.00005,.00012,sourceY); a single lowest sole contact is pinned
draftShape.sharedBodyAndTackCageDescription: The upper-body/head cage is shared. The v8 bone-aligned leg surface is body-only; the source-restored shoulder field follows reviewed breastcollar islands through a sparse attachment. Shortened Western fenders are tack-only.

rearContour.preserved: Full upper-hip mass; front body, neck, lower legs, hoof centers, seat and all non-body meshes unchanged.
rearContour.purpose: Round the rear quarter into the thigh instead of extending the broad barrel cage down the haunch.

frontContour.preserved: Broad upper shoulders and neck; rounded rear, lower limbs, seat, irons, fenders, saddle and bridle unchanged.
frontContour.purpose: Round the lower chest into the forearms, with the original breastcollar following the same field.
frontContour.contactNote: Preserves the fitted source relationship; zero collar-to-skin gap or penetration is not claimed.

stirrupTailoring.reason: Shorter Western fenders keep the existing human rider feet within reach on the broad draft body.
